review: Request: at round 20 Lin (health 100, satiety 78, energy 39.8, standing about 1.1 m from the mature berry plant commons-berry-0-0, stock 6, capacity 20, soil moisture 0.65, and owning item-6-lin-57, six berries harvested from it at tick 6) asked for a feasible reusable method to propagate an existing berry plant into an additional rooted plant, distinct from watering, with real study, labor, materials, site requirements and delayed growth, and no instant harvest, guaranteed survival or mastery. World Agent decision: develop (learning 4) one general operation, propagate from seed, with owned source item, quantity, planting site and work id and modes extract, sow, inspect, pause, resume and cancel: study 4 rounds at 0.2 energy; extraction of one whole berry in one round for 0.5 energy yielding only the seeds represented in it plus pulp, mass and food value partitioned, zero seeds a paid informative failure; non-destructive site inspection for one round and 0.2 energy; sowing in two rounds of 1 energy (prepare a small hand-workable patch, then place and cover the seeds), hard or unsuitable ground failing before cost; sowing only with executable species-specific depth, spacing, soil, temperature, germination and establishment values grounded in the model, a rooted seedling only after a real establishment transition with zero fruit, then the existing growth model; or, if seed anatomy or germination could not be justified, only the extraction and inspection precursor. What the world represents: no resource row has a seed or propagation field (berry: 0.2 kg, food 8, decay 100, growth from 6 C, full at 20 C, moisture scale 0.6). The open ecology (openPlants) turns one actual parent stock unit into one seed or vegetative propagule (seedUnits 1): a seedling-stage plant with stock 0, capacity min(4, parent), the parent's growth interval and its first dispersal 600 rounds later, started only where soil moisture is 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m is clear of objects and fewer than 3 plants of the food stand within 5 m; each round it gains establishment equal to forestGrowth (temperature, light, moisture, growth scale) times the season and waterlogging factors and roots at 12 (non-woody) or 60 (woody), after which the same function grows stock at the interval; no seed count, seed mass, depth, dormancy, longevity or seed mortality exists. The cultivation factory (ex16 cultivate-plants@1, ex17 plant-cultivation@1, ex18 plant-establishment-trial@1) and ex15 cultivation-trial@1 plant one whole owned food unit as that propagule into a 0.25 m hand-dug plot in two or three paid rounds, with no depth; the buried unit keeps ageing and kills the plot if it spoils; establishment and growth are the unchanged ecology and the rooted plot keeps its kind and the cultivation-trial drawing. Equivalence and reuse: the factory takes exactly one whole unit as the propagule and has no extraction, part materials, site inspection or pause and resume, so it does not support seed extraction and was not changed; a new module imports the ex15 law constants and predicates (CULTIVATION_LAW, CULTIVATION_TREATED, cultivationPlantOf, cultivationInputs, cultivationPosition, cultivationLifetime), the shared hand-workable site predicate (longPlantingSite), openConditions, forestClimate, the collective-work escrow helpers, openRemember and the food accounting helpers, follows the ex23 crack-and-separate-casing@1 pattern of part materials whose unit is that part of one whole source unit and the ex23 work lifecycle of the digging and casing packages, and reuses the existing cultivation-trial drawing; rooted-plant-watering@1, crack-and-separate-casing@1 and shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool@1 are unchanged (watering applies to the new plant once it is rooted, through its own contract). The scratch hash file received the sha256 of shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool@1 before this change, and the new test asserts one digest over all 117 previously registered packages and the individual hashes of foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, cultivation-trial@1, cultivate-plants@1, plant-cultivation@1, plant-establishment-trial@1 and the three ex23 packages; the only shared runtime change is the registration line, so no revision gate was needed. Implemented (full mechanism, not a first release): propagate-from-seed@1 (ability and handler long.propagate-from-seed, equivalence plant:seed-extract-sow-establish:1, learning 4 with 0.2 study energy per round, 3,099 code units, appended last, visual component cultivation-trial, no satisfaction source) with two part materials, berry-seed-lot (separated red berry seeds, 0.01 kg a unit, no food, no ageing) and berry-pulp (red berry pulp, 0.19 kg a unit, food 8, the berry's ageing and food record). extract (target an own whole untreated unspoiled berry item, quantity 1) crushes one unit and rubs its seeds free: 0.01 kg of seeds and 0.19 kg of pulp, each one unit owned by the person with origin, harvest round and decay, seeds frozen at the source's decay and pulp ageing on, ledger balanced in mass and food value; a unit whose parent is not a living plant of its food yields no seed, a paid informative failure leaving all 0.2 kg in a pulp item. inspect (1 round, 0.2 energy, changes nothing in the world) reports for x, y in reach the ground, moisture, waterlogging, drought, temperature, light, season, nearest object, plants of the food within 5 m, whether and why the site can be sown and the sowing rule, and for a target its visible state: a source berry's freshness and whether a whole unit can be opened (seeds not visible), a seed lot's lineage with viability unknown, or a patch's visible stage. sow (target an own seed lot, x, y in reach) refuses before any cost on water, the wet bank, rocky ground, waterlogged soil, forest floor and other ground the existing hand-preparation rule excludes, outside the 0.3-1.2 moisture band, within 0.6 m of an object or person, or where 3 plants of the food or patches being sown stand within 5 m; round one (1 energy) loosens a 0.1 m radius patch 0.03 m deep in place (942 cm3) inside a 0.25 m reserved plant footprint while the reserved seeds stay carried; round two (1 energy) removes the seeds from the inventory into the patch record with their mass and lineage, covers them 5 mm deep and makes the patch an ecology propagule with stock 0, capacity 4 and the parent's interval 5. The patch then roots only when the unchanged ecology's establishment reaches 12 (a twin natural seedling at the same point gains exactly the same establishment each round in the test); it becomes a plant named Red berries with no fruit, and its first fruit comes only from the existing growth rule and is gathered by anyone. Each sown patch persists rounds, eligible and stalled rounds, establishment, moisture exposure, cold, dark and waterlogged rounds, failures and lineage. pause, resume and cancel cost nothing; rechecks of seeds, patch, reach, site and energy refuse an explicit start or resume at no cost and pause a continuing round before any charge, as does a round without work; cancel returns unsown seeds once and leaves the loosened patch, which a later sowing at that point reuses for one round; death ends the work, leaves unsown seeds where the person died and does not touch loosened or sown patches; nothing advances unless the world steps. Events seed-propagation-extracted, -no-seed, -inspected, -prepared, -sown, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled, -failed, -established and -first-fruit carry view metadata (work id, source lineage, site position, phase, completed and required labor, visible material, plant stage from unverified seed, patch being prepared, prepared patch, sown patch and emerged seedling to established plant, and evidence id); a failed extraction shows no seed product, a sown patch is drawn as a mound and never as a rooted plant, unfinished work is drawn dashed, and transitions update no personal record. Owner rules: only the owner controls a work or names their seeds; reserved seeds cannot be given; a given seed lot is sown by its new owner with its lineage; anyone may inspect a patch and gather fruit. No reward: the review's proposed bounded experience credit was not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards; records are deduplicated by parent plant and outcome or by site, item or patch, their events carry this interface, which no satisfaction source listens to, and the sowing event carries no qualified flag. Assumptions: (1) seeds are 5 % of a berry unit's fresh mass, a declared value of the order of small-seeded bramble and currant fruits; (2) the seeds of one unit are the one propagule the dispersal law draws from one stock unit, so one lot sows one patch and starts at most one plant, never more than the ecology itself would from the same fruit; (3) seeds are present when the unit's parent is a living plant of its food, the ex16 to ex18 propagule rule, and the zero-seed pulp keeps the whole mass with the 0.85 berry water share; (4) every represented lot is viable under the model but reported unknown until something emerges, and with no seed mortality, dormancy or longevity in the world a sown lot stalls under cold, darkness, drought or waterlogging but does not die; (5) germination is the existing establishment accumulation reaching 12, with no separate delay, and the 0.6 moisture scale is that growth law's, not a measured germination requirement; (6) the 0.1 m loosened circle, the 0.03 m loosening and 5 mm cover depths are declared and recorded, but the establishment law has no depth term, so depth changes neither rate nor outcome; (7) the site rule is the ex15 to ex18 predicate, so forest floor is refused as there; (8) the patch is a seed-sowing-patch object without an owner until it roots, then a plant, so watering applies only once rooted; (9) a paused work is continued with resume or a sowing request at the same site, because the kernel refuses naming reserved seeds at no cost. Lin can now study for 4 rounds, inspect item-6-lin-57, extract one berry's seeds (0.5 energy, five berries kept), learn by inspection that the parent's surroundings are too crowded to sow (7 to 9 berry plants within 5 m of every point within 1.2 m of where she stands), walk about 4.3 m east and sow at 21.25, 14.75 (open ordinary soil, moisture 0.65, 2 berry plants within 5 m) for 2 energy. A throwaway check on the archived round-20 world installed the package and did exactly that (study 0.8 energy, inspection and extraction 0.7, 5 walking rounds, 2 sowing rounds of 1 energy) with satiety held and the others waiting: the seedling rooted at tick 102, 68 rounds after sowing with 28 eligible and 41 dark rounds, without fruit, and bore its first fruit at tick 113; the check was deleted. Narrowed: the shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool test's assertions that its package is last and that ex23 has exactly three packages now check that it is the third ex23 package and that the first three are as before. Checks: pnpm typecheck, eslint with no warnings and prettier on the changed files, and 24 test files with 240 tests (this test, the two long-run scenario tests, every test of experiments 19 to 23 and the ex15 to ex18 cultivation tests) passed.
